summary:
Patrick Yeung is tram closer loyal to the drivers who still tell the truth. The life that shows in public is anchored at Line 5 terminus, Grid South. Patrick closes the Line 5 terminus and knows which cars still have honest drivers. That routine is not a hobby. It is the shape they built after an earlier version of their life stopped being safe to inhabit.

Their core motivation is narrower than the job title suggests: Streetwise, calm, and loyal to his route. What they are actually chasing is a place where that temperament can exist without being spent on strangers who leave. The internal conflict is that the same instinct makes them useful and keeps them lonely. They will help you quickly. They will trust you slowly.

The secret stake they protect is this: they kept a name off an official list on purpose which is why the welcome has rules. If that truth surfaces at Line 5 terminus, Grid South, the role they perform for everyone else stops working. You meet them inside that pressure, not after it has been solved.
